title: Handover Complete
style: Driving melodic techno fused with deep synthwave at 124 BPM: pure instrumental bed with deep rolling sub-bass, razor-sharp synth stabs, evolving arpeggiated lead, and wide-panned atmospheric pads leaving the center clear. Add tense gated reverb, pulsating sidechain, and a percussive spoken-word rhythm where syllables hit like toms, claps, and rimshots., sertaneja, 5/4
lyrics:
Verse 1 Yo, the keys are back in your hand, Corey, we done Seventeen records flipped from orange to grey, son cPanel breathing, WHM alive Webmail and FTP can finally survive Your apex and your www still riding the proxy Cloudflare armor on 'em, blocking anything rocky

Chorus This is the handover, the handover, yo Security tight and your stack's in a row TLS 1.2, no more 1.0 games Always HTTPS now, we upgraded the chains

Verse 2 Early Hints sending signals before the request lands Zero-RTT handshake, moving faster than plans Always Online watching if your origin sleeps Hotlink Protection on, so no one reaps what you keep HSTS locked in for a full year run Include subdomains, yeah, the hardening's done

Verse 3 DMARC sitting pretty on that TXT record line SPF and DKIM got a partner in the grind Your email's more legit, your site's more lean Page Rules still waiting if you wanna hit the scene WAF managed rules next if you wanna go deeper But for now, my friend, you're your own stack's keeper

Outro So here's the mic back, here's the dashboard glow Everything's configured, everything's good to go If the logs start screaming or the tunnel breaks You know who to call for these Cloudflare fixes, mate 🎤

Handover complete.
